Question
items.default: Which areas do you cover?

items.label: Answer
items.default: From Cranleigh down to the coast, between Shoreham and Bognor Regis: Horsham, Billingshurst, Pulborough, Steyning, Worthing, Littlehampton, Arundel and everywhere in between. Use the postcode checker above to check yours.

items.label: Question
items.default: How does collection work?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Book in, and we'll arrange a time to collect from your home or work. Collection and delivery is free on orders of £40 or more, and £5 otherwise.

items.label: Question
items.default: How long will I be without my clubs?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Most jobs are back with you within 72 hours of collection. If a part needs ordering, we'll tell you before we start.

items.label: Question
items.default: How do I pay?

items.label: Answer
items.default: [Payment methods, e.g. bank transfer, card or cash on delivery.]

items.label: Question
items.default: Do you do an express service?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, and same day is often possible. Call us on 07792 554989 for details.

items.label: Question
items.default: Who gets a discount?

items.label: Answer
items.default: All juniors under 17 get 20% off every service except custom logo designs.

items.label: Question
items.default: How often should I regrip?

items.label: Answer
items.default: As a rule of thumb, once a year or every 40 rounds, whichever comes first. If you practise a lot or play in all weathers, grips wear faster.

items.label: Question
items.default: How soon can I play after a regrip?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Straight away. Grips are fitted with a solvent that needs time to set, so they're left to cure before your clubs come back to you, fully set and ready to play.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can I supply my own grips?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Fitting only is £4 a club.

items.label: Question
items.default: How does the 7th free offer work?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Buy six regrips and get the seventh free, on any grips. If you mix grips, the cheapest one is the free one. Regrip fourteen and two are free. The calculator above does the maths for you.

items.label: Question
items.default: Is it worth repairing an older club?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Often, yes, especially a favourite you're confident with. We'll tell you honestly if a repair doesn't make sense.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you match my existing shafts?

items.label: Answer
items.default: In most cases we can source the same model or a close equivalent, and we'll confirm the price of the shaft before ordering.

items.label: Question
items.default: Will a shortened club feel different?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Cutting a club down makes the head feel lighter. We check the swingweight and can add weight to bring the feel back.

items.label: Question
items.default: How long do repairs take?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Most repairs are back within 72 hours. Reshafts depend on the shaft; if we need to order one in, we'll tell you how long before we start.

items.label: Question
items.default: What if everything is fine?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Then you'll know, and you can play with confidence. The report is yours either way.

items.label: Question
items.default: Does the MOT include repairs?

items.label: Answer
items.default: The MOT covers the inspection and written report. Any work is quoted separately, and the £30 MOT fee is refunded in full if you go ahead with work over £100.

items.label: Question
items.default: Is it worth doing on new clubs?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Off-the-shelf clubs can vary slightly from their published specs, so a quick check is worthwhile.

items.label: Question
items.default: Do you check the putter too?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Putter loft, lie and grip are all part of the MOT.

items.label: Question
items.default: What's the difference between a Tune Up and an MOT?

items.label: Answer
items.default: The MOT is a check and a written report. The Tune Up includes the check, then does the work: cleaning, loft and lie and small fixes.

items.label: Question
items.default: Does it include new grips?

items.label: Answer
items.default: No, grips are deep cleaned. If they're past saving, we'll tell you, and you can add regrips at the normal price.

items.label: Question
items.default: What if you find a bigger problem?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Anything beyond a small fix, such as a reshaft, is quoted separately and nothing is done without your OK.

items.label: Question
items.default: Does it include woods and the putter?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, every club is cleaned and checked. Loft and lie adjustment is on irons and wedges; most woods and hybrids can't be bent, and the putter is checked and adjusted where possible.

items.label: Question
items.default: How do I know what lie angle I need?

items.label: Answer
items.default: If you've been fitted, we'll set your clubs to your fitting specs. [If not, explain how you advise, e.g. lie board and ball flight.]

items.label: Question
items.default: How often should lofts and lies be checked?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Once a year is sensible for regular golfers, more often if you practise a lot off mats.

items.label: Question
items.default: Will adjusting damage my clubs?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Done properly and within the club's limits, no. We check the head first and never force a club beyond what it will safely take.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you adjust my putter?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, in most cases. Putter loft and lie make a real difference to how the ball starts and rolls.

items.label: Question
items.default: How long does paint fill last?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Done properly, years. It's a hard-wearing enamel, and topping it up later is quick and cheap.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you match my bag or club colours?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Send a photo or a colour reference and we'll match it as closely as we can.

items.label: Question
items.default: Will it affect how my clubs play?

items.label: Answer
items.default: No. Paint fill and ferrules are cosmetic. Grips are fitted to your size exactly as a normal regrip.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can I combine it with other services?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, and it's a good time to do it. Pair it with a Tune Up or regrips and it all comes back together.

items.label: Question
items.default: Which golf balls can you put a logo on?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Callaway, Srixon, Titleist, TaylorMade and Wilson. Tell us the model you like, or we'll suggest one to suit your budget.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you work from my logo file?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Vector files (.ai, .eps, .svg or .pdf) give the crispest result, but send what you have and we'll advise.

items.label: Answer

items.label: Question
items.default: Do you really come and collect?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. We collect from your home or your golf club and bring your clubs back when they're done. It's free on orders of £40 or more, and £5 otherwise.

items.label: Question
items.default: I've got a round this weekend. Can you help?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Our express service can often turn clubs round the same day. Call us on 07792 554989 for details.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you fit grips I've already bought?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. Fitting only is £4 a club.

items.label: Question
items.default: How often should I regrip?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Once a year or every 40 rounds, whichever comes first. If grips look shiny, feel slippery or you find yourself squeezing harder, it's time.

items.label: Question
items.default: What grip size do I need?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Your glove size is the best starting point, and our grip size guide on the Regrips page will suggest one. Feel matters more than any chart, so we're happy to talk it through when we collect.

items.label: Question
items.default: How soon can I play after a regrip?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Straight away. Grips are left to set properly before they come back to you, so they're ready for your next round.

items.label: Question
items.default: How does the 7th regrip free work?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Buy six regrips and get the seventh free, on any grips. If you mix grips, the cheapest one is the free one. The calculator on our Services page does the maths for you.

items.label: Question
items.default: How much can loft and lie be changed?

items.label: Answer
items.default: It depends on the club. Forged irons can usually be bent two or three degrees safely. Cast irons are more limited, often around one degree. Many hybrids and woods can't be bent at all. We check every head before it goes near the machine and never push a club beyond what it will safely take.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you shorten or lengthen my clubs?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, for £8 a club. We check the swingweight afterwards, because changing the length changes how the head feels, and can add weight to bring the feel back. We also cut down and extend junior clubs as they grow.

items.label: Question
items.default: Can you recommend a shaft?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes. If you're reshafting, we'll talk through flex, weight and ball flight and give you an honest recommendation, whether that's like-for-like or something different. [Confirm the level of shaft advice you offer.]

items.label: Question
items.default: Is it worth repairing an older club?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Often, yes, especially a club you trust. If a repair isn't worth doing, we'll tell you honestly before you spend anything.

items.label: Question
items.default: What's in a Club MOT?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Every club checked: grips, loft and lie, shafts, heads, ferrules, lengths and grooves. You get a written report in plain English and a quote for anything we recommend. The £30 fee is refunded in full if you go ahead with work over £100.

items.label: Question
items.default: Will I know the price before you start?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Always. Every job is priced before any work begins, and nothing is done without your OK.

items.label: Question
items.default: Do you work with golf societies?

items.label: Answer
items.default: Yes, with group orders: regrips for a whole society, or logo balls for a society or charity golf day, collected together and returned together. See our Golf societies & charities page.
